reason: I already have my Toplux and I reorder it when it runs out, and money is tight. The lab report is nice but I'm not switching a routine for a brand I've never heard of.
objection: Thirty foil sachets a month is a lot of packaging waste, and $29.99 is more than I want to spend when I already have something I take.
would_change_my_mind: If my doctor's blood test showed I really was low and it cost clearly less than what I pay now, around $15 to $18 a month, I'd try one box.
